fact: The document says the Federal Government will unveil the National Single Window, a unified payment platform bringing revenue collection agencies together, in the first quarter of 2026.
FIRS states all tax and levy collections must be processed through assessments raised on the TaxPro Max platform, which handles payment processing and receipts.

The Central Bank of Nigeria's draft e-payment of taxes guidelines state that an e-tax card, a debit card letting taxpayers pay tax online without visiting a bank, 'was introduced' as a payment option.

The Central Bank of Nigeria's draft guidelines set out requirements for electronic payment of all taxes, levies, duties and fees at all levels of government, with business taxes to be paid electronically on a stated timetable.
